title: go-cad gold-oracle boundary and CADCraft peer-status correction
mode: Primary-source research and implementation-readiness update; research-only
scope: Deepen the already-screened go-cad candidate's evidence, corpus, and oracle classification.
Refresh CADCraft dimension-flag, absent-INSUNITS, and AutoCAD AUDIT report status.
Map peer observations to existing local test/consumer owners without duplicate validation or support promotion.

sources.revision: Mutable main pages reviewed 2026-10-19; no immutable commit or tagged artifact was obtained.
sources.observed: The README claims R9-R2018 DWG reading, R2000-R2018 writing, 37 drawings with 34 strict gold-alignment rows, an official-corpus workflow, and DXF ASCII/Binary checks. It explicitly lists ACIS reconstruction as unsupported. Its named gold paths use LibreDWG dwgread -O JSON and dxf2dwg. The rendered repository page exposed test filenames and testdata but exact source/corpus contents could not be inspected in this pass.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A potentially source-distinct structural differential; not an independently authored semantic oracle, not a qualified artifact result, and not 3D/ACIS evidence.

sources.revision: Issue and PR pages reviewed 2026-10-19; PR branch commit shown as 0d5eccb and remains open.
sources.observed: Issue #1094 is closed through #1096, but the PR page remains open and says the branch is not deployed. The PR describes a CADCraft bridge change mapping DXF group-70 DIMENSION bits to DWG Flags 1 in both directions and reports raw-byte vectors for four dimension families.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Unmerged application-bridge evidence in the ACadRust family; not released behavior, a separate parser lineage, or a libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-19; issue open and no branch/PR linked on the page.
sources.observed: The report says a legacy DXF with no $INSUNITS was read from a new imperial document template and then rewritten with $INSUNITS=1. A maintainer proposes resetting imported files to unitless but no merged fix or retest is established.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-specific import default behavior; does not define universal omitted-variable semantics or coordinate scaling.

sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-19; issue remains open.
sources.observed: A user reports AutoCAD 2027 opening CADCraft's AC1018 output after an AC1032 input with plausible visuals but six AUDIT errors, including AcDbTableStyle(1109) - not fixed; no repairs or erasures were reported. The offered drawings were not downloaded.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Single user-reported native result; not an independently reproduced result or a libdxfrw failure.

localEvidence: Existing local common DIMENSION Flags 1 writer and parser vectors exercise raw values 0/1/2/3 across AC1018, AC1021, and AC1024; existing DXF frame tests cover ASCII/Binary output.
Existing 7BJ.4 header tests preserve absent $INSUNITS separately from explicit 0/1/4 and assert coordinates are not implicitly rescaled.
Existing composed native-consumer plan records requested/actual output version, open outcome, AUDIT diagnostics, graph disposition, and visual/semantic result separately.
The plan already records the CADCraft/ACadRust parser-family relationship; this review adds status freshness and evidence-denominator detail only.

assessment.planImpact: Classifies go-cad as an optional structural differential with a LibreDWG-correlated gold oracle and no ACIS semantics. Corrects CADCraft issue freshness while preserving existing local DIMENSION/header tests and the single composed native gate; no routine peer/native validation is added.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review plus local source/test/plan crosswalk
method.limitations: The go-cad default branch is mutable, its immutable commit and exact corpus manifest were not bound, and the rendered source-file pages were unavailable for line-level audit. CADCraft findings are reports from one ACadRust-related application lineage; issue closure, an open PR, visual appearance, and a successful native open are kept distinct from merged release behavior, clean AUDIT, or geometry semantics.
